title: Blink Video Doorbell System $27.99, Blink Outdoor Camera 2K+ 5-Pack $114 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: Blink Video Doorbell System $27.99, Blink Outdoor Camera 2K+ 5-Pack $114 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings

[pakkapie] Not worth it for alerts, should be a free feature.
ADVANCED FEATURES — As part of a Blink Subscription Plan, get alerts whenever a person is detected and enjoy features like Blink Moments, or extended live view
[zxcvb] Thats crazy, even the video doorbell has live alerts without a subsription, what does this offer over a standard ring doorbell?
[jimojr] Blink Outdoor Camera 2K+ (1 Camera System, Black) + FREE Blink Video Doorbell 2K+ (Black) for $39 on Amazon .
[JoelleP] It requires a Prime member to get that price.
[3fornothing] Mates, please suggest me alternatives, I am planning to setup a system. Should I buy the 5 pack as it economical or go for Tapo Cameras? Need at least 4 outside cameras and 3 indoor cameras.
[zukime] Def Tapo. Own blink and they are not that great. Its okay for the price but have heard great things about Tapo Cameras.
[pepper123] Am I understanding correctly that recordings arent saved without a subscription?
[jimojr] Get a Blink Sync Module 2, and you can save recordings to a USB flash drive without a subscription.
[sk213] These are absolute trash, bought 4 and a doorbell cheap, have the sync module with a USB drive. Consistently misses things, slow as hell, don't even think about trying to do two things at once.
